who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), write-only lane I, piece 'bodies written by expansions are checked and covered' on rebuild-1115
what: Every `runner.py ask` stops at start-up with `NameError: name 'LOCK' is not defined`: `ME = {..., "lock": LOCK, ...}` (line 29) reads LOCK before line 32 defines it (the two-worker edit, WORKERS on line 28). The lane's only allowed command cannot run, so the piece is written but neither trialled nor admitted.
cost: two asks refused with no build; the piece waits for the runner
cause: a module-level name used before its assignment in the runner's own edit
whys: the runner is edited in place while lanes ask, with no check that it still imports
class: the one build door edited live with no smoke run of its own
prevention: edit runner.py as a copy and swap it in after `python3 -I runner.py --help` (or an ask of a no-op lane) runs; or move ME below LOCK
workaround: none for a lane that may run only the runner: report and wait
